answer: The ledger answers every claim with yes or no, and it has never once been talked out of an answer. Hold 178 POA hostage per mask and a farm of 392 masks has 69776 POA frozen before the epoch opens. Where farms spot a gap, Gear cutter pendulum warrant struck within the observatory finds a record, and the record reads each pendulum is a measured beat rate and a master signature. The ripple opens the gate, the wander pays the toll, the horizon proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer pays. An honest proof ages like a good movement; a farm proof rusts before the epoch ends.
